summary: Iteration 1 — Cosmic Elemental MVP Phase 1 backend + frontend tested end-to-end against public preview URL. Wrote pytest suite (19 tests, all pass) covering auth, roles, events/classes/artists CRUD + admin approval, bookings, uploads, payments (free + paid Stripe session creation), admin stats & pending. Ran Playwright UI tests covering landing hero, signup + role selector -> dashboard redirect, dashboard 'new event' modal submission (item appears with Pending badge), admin console (stats cards, pending list with Approve/Reject working, bookings tab lists items), artist detail 'Book this artist' modal + submission. Found and fixed one critical UI crash bug (missing X import in Detail.jsx that would have broken the BookingModal close button).

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED by testing agent — `X` icon was used in modal header but not imported from lucide-react, causing a ReferenceError that would crash the booking modal render.

issues: Empty string was passed to ; caused benign console warning on cards without poster/image. Consider guarding src (skip render if url is falsy).

action_items: Optional: pass `null` or skip when it/poster_url/avatar_url is empty string, to eliminate the browser 'empty src' console warning across Cards, Dashboard, and Admin.

CORS is currently `allow_origins=['*']` with `allow_credentials=True`; browsers ignore Set-Cookie in that combination. Bearer-token auth works, but the httpOnly cookie strategy is effectively unusable for the SPA. Consider tightening allow_origins to FRONTEND_URL if cookie-based auth is required.

Server prefers cookie over Authorization header in get_current_user (server.py L65-68). This is intentional but caused surprising cross-request behavior during testing when a shared requests.Session cached one user's cookie. Consider preferring the Bearer header or clearing cookie on logout more aggressively.
critical_code_review_comments: Detail.jsx: X icon missing from lucide-react import (fixed).
server.py CORS: allow_origins=['*'] + allow_credentials=True is a spec-invalid combination — cookies won't be honored by browsers.
Dashboard.jsx ArtistProfileForm uses `` even when the URL is an empty string leading to 'empty string was passed to src' warnings.
server.py: get_current_user prefers cookie over Bearer header — consistent but may cause session collisions in multi-user test scenarios.
